remarks: EXCELLENT COMMERCIAL/RESIDENTIAL OPPORTUNITY!  This spacious 2 story home situated on 3.8 beautifully manicured acres holds a 30 x 42 Morton Building and is zoned B-2 (General Business Use   District) The home is currently tenant occupied and is being used as a residential dwelling. Just a few minutes north of Millersport Highway, this property has 100 feet of frontage and is 1529 feet deep.  The unique floorplan in the home lends itself to office / living space combination. The rear entrance has a 24 x 24 open room w/ mini-split air conditioner, high ceiling, indoor-outdoor carpeting and just a few steps to enter the home.  The kitchen offers a convenient breakfast bar, ceramic tile flooring and an abundance of Oak cabinets. The refrigerator, stove and dishwasher are included.  An open floorplan into the dining/living room combo. Attractive French door entry to the front den/study with multiple windows and ceiling fans. Also on the first floor is a full bath boasting tiled floors and walls, tub/shower combo and large vanity. Upstairs are 3 good size bedrooms. The primary room offers a sitting area and excellent closet space. This floor holds a convenient half bath. Ceiling fans in all bedrooms.  The side deck has an entrance to the 12 x 10 utility / mud room as well as basement access.  One of two access points to the full basement which holds the laundry area and excellent storage.  The Morton Barn measures 30 x 42 and has electric and concrete flooring. This prime location provides excellent accessibility and visibility for your business venture.  List of permitted uses available.
